answer: An copycat running 23 aliases hence needs 24 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are logged in yarrow, expire in opal, and glacier lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 12 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3207 identities would post 3203 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
